chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 124: Mo Fengwu - Han Li's New Social Tactic
chapter_meta_description: Han Li navigates the treacherous social waters of the Mo Estate. He secures cooperation through a bluff, makes a valuable ally in the gentle Mo Fengwu, and returns to the underworld for a crucial lead on local immortals. A masterclass in Mortal Stream strategy.
og_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality - Chapter 124
og_description: Han Li uses politeness as a weapon against a gentle beauty, and brute force as a management tool for his criminal underlings. The cultivation world feels closer than ever...
twitter_title: RMJI Ch.124: The Art of the Social Bluff
twitter_description: Han Li trades threats for smiles to win a valuable ally in the Mo family. But back in the underworld, a new lead on the local Immortals has him ready for his next move.
